_provenance: The TRUSTED anchor manifest of exp_14: which files are the 100 % (tier-S) anchors of each arm, and what their bytes must be. It lives in the repository, under review and under git, precisely because the anchor_cells.json that may sit beside the cells themselves is mutable and would otherwise authenticate itself (codex D3-fix finding 1). An external manifest may FILL a null sha256 here; it may never contradict a non-null one, and it may neither add nor remove files.
